primary_objective: Make the visible upper body clearly and substantially slimmer at first glance while preserving same-person visual identity and the original garment identity.

editable.shoulder_width: reduce clearly and coherently with ribcage width
editable.upper_arm_volume: reduce clearly without shrinking hands or phone
editable.shirt_drape: reconstruct over the slimmer body; preserve oversized/washed-shirt identity while removing unnecessary boxy bulk
editable.posture: may subtly recenter or lengthen torso when it improves the whole-person proportion
editable.negative_space: may increase naturally between arms and torso
editable.occlusion: rebuild sleeves, arms, hands and phone relationships when needed

identity_anchors: same hairstyle, hair color and downward gaze
garment_hard_constraints: preserve the same black washed CALIFORNIA / LONG BEACH / SUNSET T-shirt identity
preserve loose untucked length covering the waist and abdomen
do not convert the shirt into a crop top, tank, sleeveless top, cold-shoulder top or exposed-midriff garment
foreground_hard_constraints: hands must remain anatomically plausible and close to source size
phone must remain recognizable and close to source pose/location
do not use hand or phone shrinking as a slimming shortcut
qa_gates: face and hairstyle still read as the same person
shoulders, upper arms, torso and waist change as one coherent system
shirt construction and graphic identity remain credible
hands and phone are not malformed or disproportionately rescaled
newly exposed background and occlusions are photographically plausible

learned_evidence.lightning_v1_keypoint: Strong body slimming succeeded, but garment shape and hand/phone relations drifted too far.
learned_evidence.lightning_v2_silhouette: Standalone silhouette was interpreted as appearance/content rather than a pure geometry constraint; garment identity degraded.
learned_evidence.lightning_v3_source_garment: Removing explicit structure did not solve garment preservation and produced a hard reject.
learned_evidence.implication: Abstract structure images are not ControlNet-equivalent in the tested Lightning backend; garment, hand and phone preservation must be treated as explicit hard constraints and compared across backends.

hard_rule: Naturalness is a final visual QA gate, not a limiter on slimming strength.
promotion_rule: No generated result is promoted to Accepted Baseline without explicit user approval.
privacy: No portrait or control images belong in this public repository. Runtime assets are private/local or encrypted in transit.
